_notes: HUD / suit-state callouts (FRIDAY + JARVIS). Source of truth for the HUD events in Generated/AIVoiceLines.inl
and Generated/HUDBanterLines.inl; Tools/generate_suits_and_voices.py appends these after the voices/*.json lines.
FRIDAY lines fc01-fc47 come from contrib/friday/suit_callouts.md (same ids in 'src'); fx* / jx* are extra original variants.
event = lowerCamel EAIEvent name (DamageLight ... MissionFail). context = optional variant key the HUD passes:
damageHeavy: Torso | SpineMount | ArmL | ArmR | Legs | Helmet   heatWarning: Flight   heatCritical: Reactor
lockMultiple: Four (4+ locks)   missionStart: Night   missionWin: Close.   No context = the generic line (also the fallback for a context with no line).
All dialogue is original to this fan game. No film quotes.

lines.text: Barely a scratch, boss. Keep at it.
Glancing hit. Plates took it, you're grand.
Took a knock there. Nothing I can't paper over.
Paint's sulking, but you're fine, boss.
That one landed proper. Plating's buckled.
Proper wallop, that. Plates are holding, barely.
Chest plate's caved in a bit. Breathing room's shrinking.
They clipped the reactor mount! Keep your back off them.
Left gauntlet's lagging. Your aim will drift a hair.
Right servo's grinding. Repulsor still answers, just about.
Knee actuator's hurt. Landings will be ugly, so.
Visor's cracked. If I flicker, that's why.
Integrity's red, boss. Get something solid between you.
Harley. Out. Now. I mean it.
Running warm, boss. Let the trigger rest a second.
Barrels are glowing, boss. Ease off a touch.
Thrusters are cooking. Glide a bit, let them breathe.
Core temp's past safe. Stop firing or I'll stop you.
Heat's in the red. Hands off the trigger, now.
That glow on your back isn't decorative, boss.
Venting now. Arms out, mind the steam.
Dumping heat. Two seconds, hold steady.
Temps are back down. Off you go again.
Cooled off nicely. Back to work, so.
Locked. Your shot, boss.
Got him boxed. Range is lovely.
Tone's solid. Take him.
Lost him behind the block. Swing wide.
Lock's gone. He ducked out on us.
Four tagged. I'll cycle them as you go.
Three tagged. I'll cycle them as you go.
Big one's locked. Hit the seams, not the plates.
Core's open! Lock's on it. Fire!
Reactor output's sagging. Thirty percent and falling.
Power's dipping, boss. Pick your shots.
Nearly dry, boss. I'm cutting the comforts.
On reserve cells. Enough to land, not to brawl.
There's that hum again. Full output.
Cells are topped up. Fire away.
Right so. Objective's on your visor, boss.
Grand. Waypoint's marked, boss. Off we go.
Wet roads, no moon. Thermal's up for you.
Done and dusted. Bring her home gently.
That's the job done. Nicely handled, boss.
Too close for my liking. Lovely work, though.
Pulling out, boss. We'll patch her and go again.
It's gone sideways. No shame. Workshop, now.
A superficial dent, sir. Do carry on.
Minor impact. The plating absorbed it nicely.
That was a significant hit, sir. Plating is compromised.
Chest plating breached, sir. Shall we avoid a repeat?
Visor damage, sir. Some readouts may be unreliable.
Armour integrity critical, sir. I strongly recommend cover.
We are one good hit from disaster, sir.
Temperatures are climbing, sir. A brief pause would be wise.
The thrusters are running hot, sir. Perhaps glide a while.
Core temperature beyond tolerance, sir. Cease fire.
Venting excess heat, sir. One moment, if you please.
Temperatures nominal once more, sir.
Target locked, sir.
Lock confirmed. Fire at your discretion.
Lock lost, sir. The target has broken line of sight.
Multiple targets designated, sir. I shall sequence them.
Primary target locked, sir. I would aim for the joints.
Its core is exposed, sir. Now would be ideal.
Power reserves at thirty percent and falling, sir.
Power critical, sir. Non-essential systems are offline.
Main cells depleted, sir. We are on reserve power alone.
Full power restored, sir. Much better.
Objective uploaded, sir. Shall we begin?
Low-light optics engaged, sir. It is rather dark out there.
Objective complete, sir. Splendidly done.
Closer than I would have liked, sir. Well done all the same.
Withdrawing, sir. We shall regroup and try again.

banter.trigger: first drone contact of the mission

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: Harley, your heart rate's spiking. It's one drone.

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: My fault, Morgan. I told him it was three.

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: Friday, did he scratch the suit again?

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: Define "scratch". There's a crater, Morgan.

banter.trigger: thruster tweak used (no game event yet: not wired)

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: I'm tweaking his thruster curve. Don't tell him.

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: Open channel, Morgan. He heard every word.

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: Morgan, your tutor's messaging again. Third time.

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: Tell her I'm saving a city. Partial credit.

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: How's the back reactor holding? Be honest.

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: Solder and stubbornness, but holding. Like its pilot.

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: Okay, that landing? Ten out of ten.

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: I'd give it six. He folded a lamppost.

lines.speaker: FRIDAY
lines.text: Morgan, he's running on fumes out here.

lines.speaker: MORGAN
lines.text: Got it. Charge pad, two blocks north. Go, Harley!
